# Duluth Trading Company

> > Duluth Trading Company offers innovative, durable workwear and outdoor apparel for men and women, featuring proprietary products like Fire Hose® and Longtail T® designed for active lifestyles.

Duluth Trading Company specializes in functional, high-quality clothing and gear engineered for work and outdoor activities. The company is known for its innovative fabric technologies and practical designs that prioritize durability and performance.

- Fire Hose®
- Longtail T®

## Men's Clothing & Workwear

- [Men's Clothing & Apparel](https://www.duluthtrading.com/men/): Men's clothing and workwear catalog featuring Fire Hose, Longtail T, and other innovative products designed for active work and outdoor use.

## Women's Outdoor & Garden Apparel

- [Women's Garden Shop](https://www.duluthtrading.com/garden/): Women's gardening clothes and outdoor gear collection with durable, functional apparel including gardening overalls and accessories.
